google/gemini-2.5-flash.mistake: In the last three statements, the natural language phrase 'does not practice dark magic' is represented by a new, independent predicate p_4(x) in the FOL, instead of using the logical negation of the predicate 'practices dark magic' (i.e., ¬p_3(x)). This creates an incorrect mapping because p_4(x) could semantically mean anything, whereas 'does not practice dark magic' has a specific logical relationship to 'practices dark magic'.

openai/gpt-5-mini.mistake: Minor caveats: (1) The NL phrase 'For every human' vs the FOL ∀x — this assumes the domain of discourse is humans; if the domain is larger, the quantification would need restriction. (2) The NL 'does not practice dark magic' was represented by a separate predicate p_4 rather than the logical negation ¬p_3; that's acceptable if p_4 is explicitly defined as that meaning but differs from writing ¬p_3.
